description: Source code implementing DL-DCCH message handling for 5G NR RRC protocol, including message type selection, serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: dl_dcch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice type for DL-DCCH message, allowing selection among various message types and extensions.

classes.name: dl_dcch_msg_type_c::c1_c_
classes.description: Nested class representing specific message content types within the choice.

classes.name: dl_dcch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the entire DL-DCCH message as a sequence containing the message content.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type option.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Selects the 'c1' message type.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets message as class extension.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the object to JSON format.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts message content to JSON.
